probe.note: ~80 rows total, ~1 GPU-min. Numbers must not enter powered arm CIs or verdict.

unseen_family_rationale.strided_read: stage-3 strided memory access; structurally distinct (non-coalesced) from seen (all coalesced/elementwise or matmul/reduction); emittable by generator_stage3.
unseen_family_rationale.gemm_naive: stage-4 compute-bound GEMM (probe arm only; only 24 specs).
unseen_family_rationale.divergent_branch: stage-5 control-flow divergence (probe arm only; only 56 specs).

split_plan.power_check: MDE at n=300 (strided_read trial) = 4.4% < 10% bar. Probe arm MDE ~15-20% at its n; reported as INCONCLUSIVE_LOW_N unless CATASTROPHIC (>2x floor).
split_plan.writeup_constraint: verdict = 'generalizes across unseen MEMORY-ACCESS families (n>=300 each)'; compute-bound and control-flow families reported as probes and as an explicit limitation. If probe arm is catastrophic, that replaces the headline.
split_plan.degradation_rule: degradation_factor = gbt_unseen_MAE / 0.3709 (seen-CV reference from 2al), computed per family AND for the analytic floor itself; the floor's own degradation must be reported.

verdict_thresholds.generalizes: degradation_factor <= 2.0 AND beats analytic floor on every powered family
verdict_thresholds.generalizes_with_degradation: beats the floor everywhere but degradation_factor > 2.0 on >=1 family (named)
verdict_thresholds.does_not_generalize: loses to analytic floor on any powered family
verdict_thresholds.probe_catastrophic: GBT MAE > 2x analytic floor on the FULL spec set

split_plan.mde_rule: MDE recomputed per family at the ACHIEVED n (bootstrap over rows, z=1.96), recorded per family; INCONCLUSIVE only when MDE exceeds the observed effect; probe arm is INCONCLUSIVE_LOW_N by construction at n=24/56 (state measured MDE).
